summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests JNJ-87704916, an oncolytic virus, alone and with cetrelimab, in advanced solid tumors, including non-small cell lung cancer. JNJ-87704916 is given as an intratumoral injection into tumors, and how long or how often it is given is not stated. The study aims to determine safety, feasibility, and the recommended doses and regimens.
summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 1 evalúa JNJ-87704916, un virus oncolítico, solo y con cetrelimab, en tumores sólidos avanzados, incluido el cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas. JNJ-87704916 se administra como inyección intratumoral, y no se indica cuánto tiempo ni con qué frecuencia se administra. El estudio busca determinar la seguridad, la viabilidad y las dosis y regímenes recomendados.
who_for: Part 1: advanced or metastatic solid tumor after all available standard of care
Part 2: metastatic or locally advanced non-small cell lung cancer confirmed by tissue or cell testing
Has at least one tumor that can be injected
Adults 18 years or older; people who can have children need a negative pregnancy test
not_for: Active disease involving the central nervous system, with some exceptions
Past or active serious herpes infection, or active herpes needing ongoing antiviral therapy
Active infection needing antibiotics, antifungals or antivirals within 7 days before the first dose, or long-term use of these drugs
Past solid organ or blood stem cell transplant
Positive HIV test or other immunodeficiency; or allergy to protein-based therapies or a significant drug allergy
